summary: Rejected the reading that negating UniverseHasExistingCause entails UniverseUncaused. U is existential over an existing cause, whereas UniverseUncaused excludes all incoming causal edges. Counterexample from review 4492957391: only the spacetime whole exists and is a spacetime part; a nonexisting concrete candidate c has the sole causal edge c → whole. N1, N2, no self-causation, whole-to-part, containment and the weak causal-concreteness floor item hold, but UniverseUncaused is false. The prose now claims only no existing cause. The existing survivor certificate independently witnesses the stronger uncaused-whole position; it does not turn that position into a consequence of negating U. No theorem, Challenge or premise is changed.
blocker: The stronger inference needs an explicit causal-endpoint existence premise; it is not added to the argument.
